lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The central mid-flank columns display distinct local maxima in a grid-like distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a Cartesian-like structural grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light highlights on the superior edge and pronounced shadows directly beneath.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or irregularity is visible on the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, stochastic high-luminance spots that contrast with the more ordered column-and-row patterning of the lateral flank.
